findings.what: No designer story: role, team, timeline, problem, outcome are optional and lyrie sets none, so the brief plate shows only Client, Region, Category, Scope. A reader cannot learn what Filip did or what changed.
The only prose is client-pitch copy about Lyrie; nothing first-person about the designer's contribution, constraints, trade-offs or results.
The impact slot holds product features, not design outcomes: no metrics, no before and after, no decisions with reasons. Reads as the client's brochure.
Title promises Brand Identity and Product Design, but 2 of 3 screens are the marketing site hero; no logo, palette, type, components, flows or process artefacts.
p.lede (the one-line pitch) is never rendered on the case; the cover has a generic h1 with no thesis, role or outcome.
Five unscrollable 100vh plates (~250 words) plus a second horizontal axis: no skimming, no jumping, the 3 screens never seen together.
Small top-weighted content blocks: ~40% of each plate is dead space; ragged column bottoms on plate 2.
Mockup UI text renders at ~5-8px with no zoom/open-large; device mockup sliced at the bottom and left edges.
Cover ShotFrame crops the marketing screenshot mid-sentence; its text is ~8px and unreadable.
Same facts repeated (Lyrie x4, Cybersecurity / Brand Identity x3) while role and timeline are missing; Region and Client rows are filler.
Four competing numbering schemes ([003] WORK · 05/05, plate counter, slide counter, NEXT PROJECT · [01]); [003] means nothing to a visitor.
Case ends on the next project only: no results summary, no get-in-touch step, no Behance link for lyrie.
Heavy condensed uppercase display headlines (standing rejection 'bold display headlines'); the h1 omits the project name.
Small targets and type: '<- ALL WORK' 83x19, counter 17x28; captions, spec labels and slide hint at 12px, address pill 11px.
.shot padding 8vw vs var(--pad) elsewhere: caption edge ragged against plates 1-2.
'05 / 05' counter on the orange glare reads washed out (unverified).
Tool flags 1:1 on hollow accents (stroke-only); readable in the shot; light theme not checked (unverified).
Template has no slot for process images, annotated screens or before/after (unverified beyond code).
